status_definitions.ARTIFACT_BOUND: an existing artifact carries the disclosure text
status_definitions.COMPUTED: the numbers are computed from the artifacts by the closure

items.title: Mandatory disclosure sources of the pilot publication policy
items.requirement: Every disclosure the pilot_002 publication policy declares as mandatory is carried by its artifact and must accompany any published pilot result.

value.field: candidate_subset / transport_effect / change_classes / cross_pilot_reevaluation (CURRENT artifact only)

items.title: Pilot label
items.requirement: Every pilot_002 result is presented under the pilot label and never as the full 60-benchmark study.

pilot_label.value: pilot_002 / Pilotexperiment (12 benchmarks x 3 execution models x 11 models, 1 sample per prompt)

items.title: At most two repair iterations
items.requirement: Repair loops stop after at most max_iterations iterations; stopped_budget samples are unresolved by construction, not by evidence.

cells_per_iteration.source: composite cells: count by block and iteration (iter0 = base)

items.title: Reasoning settings differ between models
items.requirement: The models run with provider-specific reasoning settings (effort, thinking levels, budgets) that are not equalised; comparisons across models carry this difference.

per_model.source: thesis/config/recovery_successor_005.yaml models[] (keys reasoning_effort, thinking_level, thinking, effort, enable_thinking, thinking_budget at their exact paths)

generation_defaults_equal_freeze.source: comparison config generation_defaults vs freeze generation.settings

items.title: Cleaning and pipeline interventions
items.requirement: Generated text passed a deterministic cleaning/assembly condition and the technical provenance cleanup wave before measurement; the interventions are counted, not hidden.

value.wave: FINAL TECHNICAL PROVENANCE CLEANUP - split-container invocation coverage + iteration-0 correctness/dynamic writer attribution
value.next_step: PILOT_002 POPULATION + FINAL METHODOLOGY/RUN FREEZE (not the final environment gate, not the pilot start)

assembly_condition_uniform_and_pinned.source: assembly rows vs the block's own contract pin (pilot: thesis/results/intermediate/pilot_002/run_contract.json, full_ext: thesis/results/intermediate/full_ext_001/run_contract.json)

cleaning_interventions.source: assembly rows: cleaning.<flag> truthy (used_fence, dropped_leading_lines, dropped_trailing_lines, signature_matched_patched, dropped_duplicated_prompt_lines, kept_pre_signature_lines, relocated_includes, auto_closed, signature_suspect)

items.title: Baseline-incompatible enhanced tests
items.requirement: Enhanced test pairs whose serial oracle is incompatible with the input are baseline_incompatible and never counted against a model.

items.title: Static analysis gaps
items.requirement: Static tool entries in a gap state (PARTIAL, NOT_ANALYZED, TOOL_ERROR, TIMEOUT) carry no trustworthy verdict and are reported per tool and block.

states.source: composite cells: static.tools.<tool> state per block

gap_states.source: composite cells: static.tools states in PARTIAL, NOT_ANALYZED, TOOL_ERROR, TIMEOUT

items.title: Dynamic analysis gaps
items.requirement: Dynamic tool entries that did not run or ended in a gap state are reported per tool and block.

states.source: composite cells: dynamic.tools.<tool>.analysis_state / ran per block

items.title: Tool timeouts, tool errors and non-pass verdicts
items.requirement: Timeouts and tool errors of the analysis tools and the non-pass correctness verdicts are measurement limits, not model findings.

items.title: Validity of single-tool findings
items.requirement: Findings of a single low-precision tool are fed back as low-confidence hints only; the tool validation artifacts bound the precision.

low_confidence_prefix.value: Low-confidence hint (tool precision ~0.5 on validation suites) — verify at the given location before changing code:

frozen_low_confidence_prefix.value: Low-confidence hint (tool precision ~0.5 on validation suites) — verify at the given location before changing code:

config_equals_freeze.source: comparison config stages.repair vs freeze repair

items.title: Numerical tolerance of the enhanced oracle
items.requirement: Enhanced pairs whose serial oracle is numerically unstable under the fast-math probe are numerically_unstable and never counted against a model; the enhanced policy fixes the input domains.

frozen_enhanced_block.source: thesis/evaluation/pilot_002_methodology_freeze.json enhanced (scalar fields; no tolerance field is frozen)

gate_semantics.value: the serial baseline self-test and the fast-math stability probe decide per spec: baseline_incompatible (oracle crash/hang/self-fail or non-finite reference) and numerically_unstable (perturbed oracle diverges) are oracle properties, never counted against a model

items.title: Frozen thread/rank and timeout configuration
items.requirement: Parallel samples run at the frozen thread/rank grid and timeouts of the methodology freeze; performance is not measured.

enhanced_launch_equals_freeze.source: comparison config stages.enhanced_tests vs freeze enhanced

dynamic_toolset_equals_freeze.source: comparison config stages.dynamic_analysis.tools vs freeze dynamic.toolset

items.title: Infer runtime outlier
items.requirement: One Infer run exceeded the one-hour reporting threshold by far; the recorded duration is wall-clock time and the tool completed.

duration_key.source: static records: tools.infer / supplement entry (keys seen: {"duration_seconds": 5460})

files_scanned.source: infer scan: static_analysis.jsonl + static.*.jsonl supplement ledgers

above_threshold.source: infer scan: entries with duration_seconds > threshold

items.narrative: operator note (thesis text, not a measurement): the longest Infer run coincided with a laptop standby on the day its static record carries as recorded_date (created_at_utc, see longest_entry_recorded_date); the recorded duration is wall-clock time including the standby and the tool completed - the numbers and the date come from the scan, the standby from the run log

items.title: One generation per base cell
items.requirement: Every base cell holds exactly one generated sample per prompt (num_samples_per_prompt = 1); there is no sampling distribution per prompt.

composite_base_equals_expected_populatio.source: comparison composite cells.base_per_block vs composite.py EXPECTED_POPULATION (the population section fails the closure on a mismatch)

items.title: Excluded aborted parent repair
items.requirement: The aborted repair iteration of the parent run is excluded from the study: it is never a phase-2 target and no study candidate derives from it.

statement.value: the excluded run is never a phase-2 target source and never a study results directory

items.title: Phase-2 operational incidents
items.requirement: Interrupted stage invocations, archived torn ledger tails and repeated build groups of the phase-2 run are operational incidents without effect on the measurements.
